name: near-hit screen

rules.closing: vehicle ahead closing, time under 1.5 s (serious under 1 s)
rules.crossing: paths cross with a gap under 2 s (serious under 1 s)
rules.close_pass: Counted, then left out of the kept set. A 1 m gap on this camera flags most of the ride because the metres use an assumed camera height.
rules.cut_in: a vehicle blocks the lane while the rider is still approaching

note: A clip is kept when a vehicle is closing, the paths cross, a vehicle cuts into the lane while the rider is still approaching, or the stop would take a hard brake. The 1 m pass is counted and left out, because that distance flags most of the ride on this camera. This flags the clip for review. It does not determine liability.
